set_aside.subject: spool ceiling enforcement and refused-attempt cleanup
set_aside.text: “`store.spool_file` alone checks both ceilings of A15 rule 3 … and on a refusal keeps nothing of that file or of any file the same attempt spooled before it” contradicts `store_spool` owning “the two spool ceilings of A20, checked on publishing, and discarding every file of the refused attempt.”
set_aside.question: Does `store` perform the two ceiling checks and attempt cleanup, or does `store_spool` perform them behind `store.spool_file`?
options: `store_spool` performs the checks and cleanup; `store.spool_file` is only the exclusive public façade
`store` performs the checks and instructs `store_spool` which files to publish or discard
Split responsibility explicitly between the two modules
set_aside.default_guess: Have `store_spool` perform the checks and refused-attempt cleanup, with `store.spool_file` as the only caller-visible entry point.
